name: aetherlink-telegram
description: Connect ChatGPT, Codex, Claude and MCP clients to a private Telegram bot for notifications, confirmations, questions, tasks and file delivery.

interface.shortDescription: Private Telegram bridge for your AI agent
interface.longDescription: Send notifications, approvals, questions, task updates and files between ChatGPT and your private Telegram bot. Remote connections use OAuth with one-time Telegram pairing.
interface.defaultPrompt: Check my AetherLink Telegram inbox and tell me whether anything needs my attention.
